title: David Spares Saul on the Hill of Hachilah
description: The Ziphites reveal to Saul that David is hiding on the Hill of Hachilah, and Saul sets out with three thousand men to hunt him down. During the night, David and Abishai sneak into the camp where Saul is sleeping, but David refuses to let Abishai kill the Lord's anointed. Instead, they take the spear and water jug from beside Saul's head as proof. From a distant height, David calls out to Abner and Saul, and Saul acknowledges his sin and blesses David. [ref:1 Sam 26:1-25|1 Samuel 26:1-25]
